interpretation: Counts describe retained incomplete and complete populations. Correct observed prefixes are not full evaluation scores, evidence of mathematical failure, or permission to replace failed cells. Unknown remote sends count against the shared inference ceiling. No provider was called during reconciliation.

settlementSupplement.interpretation: The original cancelling checkpoint is preserved; a separate final private GET supplies the cancelled report. No replacement inference occurred.

cumulative.interpretation: Controls and earlier allowance are counted once. Unknown remote sends are already included in each study's inference-request count; no unobserved result is treated as free.
